about_the_game:
Soul Split is a PSX styled action rogue-lite dungeon crawler following an amnesiac sorcerer who’s been brought back from the afterlife to delve into the depths of an ancient dungeon. Conscripted into the service of a mysterious and powerful benefactor, you’ll venture into a vast dungeon overflowing with magic and monsters in pursuit of what lies at the bottom. 

Build an Arsenal of Chaos

Scavenge the dungeon's depths to craft a powerful arsenal of spells. Collect lost tomes dropped by enemies and bosses to add their move sets to your own. With eight different elements covering every imaginable category of magic, there are countless ways to burn your path to the lowest levels of the dungeon.

Explore a Deathless World

Delve deep into a subterranean world that has been warped and twisted by its many powerful inhabitants. Venture into the domains of higher beings and uncover their secrets. Discover a greater narrative through notes left by the residents of these ruined lands detailing the rich history of the world. Befriend a cast of strange creatures and odd characters each with a unique story of their own.

Fulfill Your Contract

Returned from the afterlife with little memory of your past you're immediately Inducted into the service of a mysterious benefactor. your task is to investigate a catastrophic curse of undeath that's befallen the land. Traverse the subterranean ruins of forgotten kingdoms and find out what is keeping The Reaper out, all while uncovering mysteries of the world and your past in the process.

Features

  • Explosive, fast paced, combat

  • An in-depth story adapted to the roguelike format

  • Explore a mysterious subterranean world brimming with ruthless foes

  • Several Intense and chaotic boss fights

  • A sandbox of over 100 spells split between 8 core elements

  • A variety of strange and charming characters

  • A second chance mechanic in the form of a ghost of your past life

  • An old school PSX aesthetic with a modern flourish

  • An epic greater narrative told in fragments found throughout the world

short_description: Soul Split is a spell-slinging, action rogue-lite about an amnesiac sorcerer who's usurped the power of Death itself. Burn your way to the heart of an ever shifting dungeon, discovering powerful spells, slaying strange creatures, and uncovering the secrets of a deathless world.
